title: Python
description: Repository conventions for Python code, typing and package metadata.

rules.instruction: Use the repository's formatter, lint rules and module layout. Use PEP 8 where the repository leaves a convention open.
rules.verification: Run the configured formatter and linter on the changed code.

rules.instruction: Annotate new public parameters and return values and use types supported by the project's minimum Python version.
rules.verification: Run the configured type checker and tests on the supported Python versions.

rules.instruction: For packaged code, keep the supported Python range, build configuration and runtime dependencies in the project's packaging metadata.
rules.verification: Build and install the package in a clean environment, then smoke-test its public entry point.
